title: Back-office Manager → Junior Fullstack Engineer
summary: Joined a home-services company (gutter cleaning, power washing, gutter guard installation) running the back office for its field technicians, then moved into engineering and officially started my software career.
highlights: Managed the back office for field technicians: scheduling, coordination and support for jobs in the field.
Ran marketing and cold calling to bring in new customers.
Started the company's first website, and helped recruit a senior developer to lead the main site.
As a junior developer, built and maintained React apps and Express REST APIs on PostgreSQL, including third-party integrations.
Expanded Jest coverage, sped up APIs by optimizing Express middleware and queries, and contributed reusable React components in an Agile team with CI/CD.
growth: Went from running operations to writing the software behind them, which is where my software engineering career officially began.
